name: Mulberry County 📢 [EASTER EVENT]
desc:
The date is 1997. You and your family live on a farm in rural Mulberry County where strange and paranormal events have been taking place. The state has issued an 8:00 p.m. curfew for all residents.

Do not die.

Current Version: 1.3.5 [ALPHA]
Volume 2 is currently in the works!


This horror game is inspired by the Mandela Catalogue and liminal spaces.
